verdict.rationale: Evidence shows ADK manages conversational context within a session (filtering, summarizing turns, token tracking) and lets agents persist 'Artifacts' (files/docs) beyond a single conversation, suggesting some cross-session persistence capability, but there is no explicit mention of a dedicated memory/session service, long-term memory store, or thread-linking mechanism. missing for 10: explicit Memory/Session service documentation, cross-thread retrieval API, persistence backend details, independent confirmation of memory recall across sessions.
